categories.blurb: Sample and built-in mods published by the Claude Code team. Great to learn from.

mods.name: bash-guard
mods.tagline: Blocks `rm -rf ~`, `mkfs` & fork bombs, asks before force-pushes. Works in YOLO mode

mods.name: secret-shield
mods.tagline: Claude never sees your keys: secrets in tool output become `[REDACTED:kind]` first

mods.name: slopsquat-guard
mods.tagline: Stops hallucinated & typosquatted packages: every install is checked against its registry

mods.name: cost-meter
mods.tagline: Live spend, context % and rate limits in your status line, plus what every turn cost

mods.name: tool-radar
mods.tagline: Mission control: every tool call live in a pane, with status, args, duration and failures

mods.name: files-touched
mods.tagline: Every file Claude changed this session: a +/− band above the prompt and one-key @mentions

mods.name: git-pulse
mods.tagline: Branch, ahead/behind and dirty files in the status line; a heads-up when Claude commits

mods.name: aim
mods.tagline: Pin one goal above the prompt with a timer; Claude stays on it and flags side quests

mods.name: snippets
mods.tagline: Your best prompts, one command away, with `{{selection}}`, `{{branch}}` and `{{args}}` filled in

mods.name: standup
mods.tagline: Your standup, written for you: Yesterday / Today / Blockers from your work with Claude

mods.name: tldr
mods.tagline: A one-line TL;DR under every long answer, written by a small, fast model

mods.name: done-ding
mods.tagline: Walk away: a desktop ping and a chime when a long turn finishes or Claude needs you

mods.name: buddy
mods.tagline: A tiny ASCII pet above your prompt that reacts to everything Claude does and levels up

mods.name: wrapped
mods.tagline: Spotify Wrapped for your Claude Code life: stats, streaks, persona and a share card
